head.title: You Cute Beauty Bar · Lash & Brow Studio in Kendall, FL | Ydalmis Zambrano
head.description: You Cute Beauty Bar, Kendall FL: lash extensions, brow design, facials and nail care with Ydalmis Zambrano. 5.0 rating on Google. Book online at Salons by JC, Mills Drive.
head.og_title: You Cute Beauty Bar · Kendall, FL
head.og_description: Lash extensions, brows, facials and nails. 5.0 rating on Google, 90 reviews.

parrafo.es: Beauty bar en Kendall especializado en extensiones de pestañas, diseño de cejas, faciales y cuidado de manos y pies. Ydalmis y su equipo te reciben en un espacio pensado para que te desconectes, con una copa de vino incluida en la experiencia.
parrafo.en: A Kendall beauty bar built around lash extensions, brow design, facials and nail care. Ydalmis and the team welcome you into a space made to help you unwind, with a glass of wine part of the experience.

hero.imagen_alt: Lounge seating area inside You Cute Beauty Bar with pink and mint decor

parrafo_1.es: You Cute Beauty Bar nació de la idea de construir un espacio para toda persona que quiera consentirse. Ydalmis Zambrano y su equipo atienden pestañas, cejas, faciales y uñas en un local pensado en cada detalle, dentro de Salons by JC en Town & Country Mall.
parrafo_1.en: You Cute Beauty Bar was built around one idea: a space for anyone who wants to pamper themselves. Ydalmis Zambrano and the team handle lashes, brows, facials and nails inside a studio designed down to the last detail, at Salons by JC in Town & Country Mall.

parrafo_2.es: El menú incluye desde extensiones de pestañas y diseño de cejas hasta faciales con ácido y platelet-rich plasma, tensado de piel con fibroblast pen, blanqueamiento dental, manicure y pedicure. Y para las visitas en familia, hay hasta un rincón para los más pequeños.
parrafo_2.en: The menu runs from lash extensions and brow design to chemical peel and platelet-rich plasma facials, fibroblast pen skin tightening, teeth whitening, manicures and pedicures. And for family visits, there is even a small corner for the little ones.

items.quote: I regularly get hybrid lashes and she does a spectacular job every time! They come out just how I like it and last a long time.
I have had extensions done before, but never such an amazing result. She gave me 3 options for the length, which I had never had offered in any other beauty bar. Ydalmis is an excellent technician.
